She looks directly at the camera, talking with an expressive facial expression and moving her hands naturally in front of her. (2) She begins to pull her arms out of the vest's armholes and starts to pull the entire vest over her head while laughing. The camera remains mostly static as she struggles playfully with the fabric, her face partially obscured by the vest as she tries to flip it around. (3) She successfully wears the vest backward, hunches her shoulders, and mimics a dinosaur's posture with her hands held close to her chest like claws. She moves back and forth in the kitchen, laughing and performing for the camera, showing off her 'dinosaur' look.
